description:
You are a QA engineer working on a clinical data validation library used by a hospital data integration team. The library validates patient records (demographics, lab results, medication dosages) before they are loaded into the EHR system.

The project is already open in PyCharm at /home/ga/PycharmProjects/clinical_validator.

The current test suite only covers happy-path cases and has a branch coverage of approximately 32%. Your task is to increase the test coverage to at least 75% line coverage.

Requirements:
- Add tests in tests/test_validator.py ONLY (do not modify the library source code in validator/)
- All existing tests must continue to pass
- Use: python -m pytest tests/ --cov=validator --cov-report=term-missing -v
- Focus on edge cases, boundary values, and error paths that the existing tests miss

The library is in validator/ and consists of three modules: demographics.py, labs.py, and medications.py. Read them carefully before writing tests.

metadata.occupation: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
